families.plate-flush: Plate front, flush: N-1 U inside the bay stack + a swappable filler in the spare zone.
families.plate-overhang: Plate front, overhang: N bays = N U, the frame and panels stick out a few mm.
families.bezel-flush: Exact 5.25in drive bezel, flush with the case front, patch panel cut into the bezel.
families.bezel-overhang: Exact 5.25in drive bezel, N U of rack panels overlapping the case front.
families.panels: Standalone 6in rack panels for any 6in rack.
families.modules: Rack modules: switch and KVM trays, Raspberry Pi trays and 2U blades, 40 mm fans, patch and button panels.
families.bezels: Bezels for the other PCs, no rack (fit = panel): button panel, vents, 80 mm fan.
families.rear: Printed brackets for two PCI slots: the network cables and the power cable leave the case through them.
families.covers: Keystone covers for unused ports, pushed in from the front.
families.tests: Small test prints: check them before printing a full adapter.
